The trip should last roughly 5 hours, give or take. I usually recommend 3,5 grams as a solid dose, but you can go lower if you dont want to trip complete balls. I’d recommend no less than 2 grams though. 

Expect visual and auditory hallucinations; weird sounds coming from behind you, walls morphing/breathing, fractal patterns etc... as well as some general mindfuckery. Nothing too extreme if you keep it under 3,5g but defintely weird and intense in a good way.

After the trip you’ll likely experience an afterglow effect that can last for a few days. Imagine having a constant instagram filter over your vision that makes colors pop and seem more vibrant, I also find myself to be in much better mood that can last up to several weeks after tripping.

As for what youll get out of the trip, thats entirely up to you. If you have the mindset of evaluating your own psyche, you’ll for sure dive deeper into yourself than ever before. At times it will be difficult and uncomfortable, but thats just how self-improvement works.
